clue.text: Resist love for young fellow

parts.note: to buck is to resist or kick against something
love is zero in tennis scoring, written O

explanation.surface: Advice to fight off romantic feelings for a young man.
explanation.definitionFit: Bucko is an informal, chiefly Irish, form of address for a lad or young man.

clue.text: Support husband beset by great pain

parts.note: to back someone is to support them

indicators.note: the husband is surrounded by the word for great

parts.note: ace means excellent or great

explanation.surface: Looking after an ailing husband has caused great suffering.
explanation.definitionFit: Backache is a specific bodily pain, so the general word pain covers it.

clue.text: Clubs and pubs will stock a type of mineral

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for clubs in card games

indicators.note: the pubs hold, or stock, the letter a

parts.note: an inn and a bar are both pubs

explanation.surface: Golf clubs and pubs will carry a certain mineral water.
explanation.definitionFit: Cinnabar is the red mineral form of mercury sulphide, the main ore of mercury.

clue.text: Star actors she'll fancy seeing from here?

definitions.text: Star actors she'll fancy seeing from here?

indicators.note: fancy as a verb means imagine, and as an anagram signal it reworks the letters

explanation.surface: A theatregoer dreams of watching famous actors from good seats.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram signal 'fancy' doubles as the surface verb 'imagine'; the whole clue doubles as a definition of the best seats for watching the stars.
explanation.definitionFit: The orchestra stalls are the front seats of a theatre, from which the stars are seen at close range.

clue.text: States theatre club is to be demolished

parts.note: rep is short for repertory theatre

indicators.note: something demolished is knocked down and its pieces left jumbled, so these letters get rearranged

explanation.surface: A theatre club's building is about to be knocked down, so a notice states.
explanation.walkthrough: 'States' is not the verb it seems to be: it is a plural noun, the definition. REP is the usual crossword theatre, and 'to be demolished' scrambles the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: Republics are nations or states governed without a monarch, so the plural noun matches.

clue.text: Thus exhibit a certain amount of crookedness?

definitions.text: Thus exhibit a certain amount of crookedness?

indicators.note: only part of the word crookedness is taken, the run inside it

explanation.surface: A trickster shows a degree of dishonesty.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition too: a swindler shows some crookedness, and part of the word crookedness spells the swindler.
explanation.definitionFit: A rook is a cheat or swindler, someone who would show crookedness.

clue.text: Old-fashioned pair of diamonds to have bequeathed

parts.note: passé means out of date
D is the abbreviation for diamonds in cards, so two of them
to own is to have or possess

explanation.surface: A grandmother leaves an outmoded pair of diamond earrings in her will.
explanation.definitionFit: Something passed down has been handed on to heirs, as a bequeathed item is.

clue.text: Begins to use note that's wrong, so refrains from speaking

indicators.note: the words are put in the wrong order, so their letters are reshuffled

explanation.surface: A singer starts with a wrong note and so falls silent.
explanation.definitionFit: To bite one's tongue is an idiom for holding back from saying something.

clue.text: One new employee being dealt with

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
a hand is a worker, as in farmhand

explanation.surface: A new recruit is being looked after.
explanation.definitionFit: A matter in hand is being dealt with or under control, an idiom.

clue.text: Quick, look: river's rising, and needs to be contained

indicators.note: the river is held within the word for look

parts.note: to spy is to look or catch sight of

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Britain

explanation.surface: Look sharp: the river is in flood and must be held back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Quick, look' reads as an exclamation, but 'Quick' is the definition. In a down clue 'rising' reads the river upwards, giving EED to be held within the look word.
explanation.definitionFit: Speedy is a direct synonym of quick.

clue.text: Aware special constable is on to him, criminal promises to pay

indicators.note: the constable comes on to, that is directly after, the criminal just named

parts.note: a con is a convict, a criminal
SC is the abbreviation for special constable, a volunteer police officer in Britain
IOUs are written promises to pay a debt

explanation.surface: A policeman is closing in on a crook who is offering IOUs to get off.
explanation.definitionFit: Being conscious of something means being aware of it.

clue.text: A hot break near English lake

indicators.note: to break something is to smash its order, so these letters are reshuffled

explanation.surface: A heatwave holiday near an English lake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'break' reads as a holiday, but it is the anagram signal, giving TAHO; 'near' only joins the pieces to the lake definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Lake Tahoe is a large lake in the Sierra Nevada on the California–Nevada border.

clue.text: Staggered in the morning to get a letter

parts.note: AM stands for ante meridiem, before noon
zed is the British name of the last letter of the alphabet

explanation.surface: Someone is astonished to receive a letter in the morning post.
explanation.definitionFit: Staggered here means astounded, a synonym of amazed.

clue.text: Experienced how curry tastes?

definitions.meaning: a curry is flavoured with spices, so it tastes spiced and salted

explanation.definitionFit: Seasoned means both veteran and flavoured with spices, the two senses the clue plays on.

clue.text: Requirement on Blair to promote royal layabout

indicators.note: promotion moves the letter for royal higher, that is earlier, in the word

parts.note: a need is a requirement
Eric Blair wrote under the pen name George Orwell

explanation.surface: A demand that Tony Blair raise a lazy royal's status.
explanation.walkthrough: Royal gives R; promoting it moves the R of ORWELL ahead of the D of NEED. 'Blair' looks like Tony Blair but is Orwell's real surname.
explanation.definitionFit: A ne'er-do-well is an idle good-for-nothing, a layabout.

clue.text: Upsetting pictures taken during woman's demise

indicators.note: the pictures are placed within the phrase for the woman's death

parts.note: her ending, the death of a woman
art means pictures and paintings collectively

explanation.surface: A distressing account of art being removed while a woman lay dying.
explanation.definitionFit: Something heart-rending is deeply distressing, so upsetting is a close synonym.

clue.text: Factory worker inside needs a form of head cover

indicators.note: the worker goes inside the factory word

parts.note: a mill is a factory
a worker ant is the standard crossword worker

explanation.surface: A factory worker has to wear a head covering.
explanation.definitionFit: A mantilla is a lace or silk scarf worn over the head, particularly in Spain.

clue.text: Anti-Republican expert on European political initiative

parts.note: in US politics a Democrat, DEM for short, is opposed to a Republican
arch means chief or leading, a master of an art

explanation.surface: An opponent of the Republicans is the expert on a European political move.
explanation.definitionFit: A démarche is a diplomatic step or political initiative.

clue.text: One can just about get away with it

definitions.text: One can just about get away with it

parts.words: One can just about get away with it
parts.note: read as an event rather than a person: a getaway that only barely succeeds

explanation.definitionFit: A narrow escape is an escape made by the slimmest of margins, which is getting away only just.

clue.text: Support for youngster

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of
a pup is a young dog, or a cheeky youngster

explanation.surface: Backing for a young person.
explanation.definitionFit: To prop up is a phrasal verb meaning to support.

clue.text: Singer who is making a hit?

definitions.meaning: someone who raps, knocking or striking

explanation.definitionFit: A rapper is both a rap artist and a knocker, such as a door knocker, that strikes.

clue.text: Force soldiers to join armed conflict

indicators.note: the soldiers join on to the front of the conflict word

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British Army corps
action is military fighting, as in killed in action

explanation.surface: Troops are being compelled to go to war.
explanation.definitionFit: In physics a reaction is the equal and opposite force answering any applied force.

clue.text: Fighter dispatched on cart

indicators.note: something dispatched is sent off and broken up, so the words on cart are rearranged

explanation.surface: A warrior is sent off sitting on a cart.
explanation.definitionFit: The Contras were rebel fighters in Nicaragua in the 1980s, so one is a fighter.

clue.text: Island finally runs out of top grade whisky

indicators.note: the final letter is the one that is lost

parts.note: Malta is a Mediterranean island
A is the top grade in exams

explanation.surface: An island has at last run out of its best whisky.
explanation.definitionFit: Malt is short for malt whisky, made from malted barley.

clue.text: Schoolboy howler recalled, though source is forgotten

indicators.note: called back, so the remaining letters are read in reverse order
the source, or first letter, of the word for a blunder is dropped

parts.note: a howler is a blunder or slip-up

explanation.surface: A schoolboy's howler is remembered, though nobody recalls who made it.
explanation.walkthrough: Dropping the first letter of SLIPUP leaves LIPUP, which 'recalled' turns round.
explanation.definitionFit: A pupil is a schoolchild, so a schoolboy is one example.

clue.text: Welshman first to goad priest about preaching the gospel

parts.note: Evan is a typical Welsh man's name

indicators.note: only the opening letter of goad is wanted

parts.note: Eli is the priest in the Old Testament who brought up Samuel
C is short for circa, about

explanation.surface: A Welshman is the first to prod a priest on the subject of evangelism.
explanation.definitionFit: Evangelic is an adjective for preaching or spreading the gospel, an older form of evangelical.

clue.text: Left tart after eating slice of apple and cheese

parts.note: port is the left side of a ship

indicators.note: the tart takes in, or eats, the slice of apple

parts.note: tart is a slang word for a promiscuous woman, as is slut

indicators.note: just a slice, the first letter, of apple is taken

explanation.surface: A tart was left over after a slice of apple and some cheese were eaten.
explanation.definitionFit: Port Salut is a mild French cheese originally made by Trappist monks.

clue.text: Delete article written in foreign language

indicators.note: the article is placed inside the language name

parts.note: Erse is Scottish or Irish Gaelic
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Instruction to remove an article written in another tongue.
explanation.definitionFit: To erase is to delete or rub out.
